CONFIDENTIAL.
----------
B. D.
Date ____

Information, which may be quite incorrect,
has been obtained to the effect that Mr. Baudes, French
Consul-General, after protracted negotiations held with
Mr. Takeshita, Chief of the Japanese Special Service
Organs in Shanghai, and Mr. Fu Siao-en, Mayor of the
Shanghai City Government, has reached the following
resolutions regarding the S.S.D. Courts in the French
Concession -:

1.  That the French Authorities commence the
    initiative to effect a reorganization of
    the Chinese Judicial Courts in the French
    Concession.

2.  That the highest administrative power of
    these Courts rest with the French Consul-
    General.

3.  That the French Consul-General alone possess
    the decisive power in disposing of all anti-
    Japanese and political cases.

4.  That the post of the President of the S.S.D.
    No. 2 Courts vacated by Mr. Yang Chi be
    fulfilled by Mr. Wang Shih-mou, the former
    President, who was discharged by the Chung-
    king Government.

5.  That the rendition of the Chinese Judicial
    Courts in the French Concession be not
    effected until after the formal inauguration
    of the new Central regime.

The same information adds that the aforementioned
decisions are being closely studied by the Japanese
Authorities.

--- o O o ---

IW/.
pages.zh:
机密。
---
B. D.
日期 ____

据获情报（该情报可能完全不实），法国驻沪总领事鲍德斯（Baudes）先生在与日本驻沪特务机关首长竹下（Takeshita）先生及上海市政府市长傅筱庵（Fu Siao-en）先生进行长期谈判后，就法租界内的特种刑事法庭（S.S.D. Courts）达成如下决议：

1. 由法国当局主动发起，对法租界内的中国司法法院进行改组。

2. 上述法院的最高行政权归法国总领事所有。

3. 法国总领事独揽处置所有反日案件及政治案件的决断权。

4. 杨炽（Yang Chi）先生 vacated（空缺）的第二特种刑事法庭庭长一职，由前任庭长王世谋（Wang Shih-mou）先生接任；王世谋先生此前曾被重庆政府免职。

5. 法租界内中国司法法院的移交工作，须待新的中央政权正式成立后方可实施。

同一情报还称，日本当局正在密切研究上述决定。
